primaryDecision: Reconstruct familiar roles as non-authoritative authoring presets composed from explicit responsibility slices, causal-access needs, tool/capability hints and requested authority-operation families. A RoleBundleTemplate never grants authority or control by itself. Concrete binding semantics arise only through local RoleAssignment plus admitted GPR1 authority/control sources and owner-local Game rules. Human/Agent/model/provider identity remains orthogonal to the bundle. Referee/Judge, GameMaster, Coach/Advisor, Moderator, Operator and ExperienceManager are retained as highly useful template families with variant profiles rather than universal atomic roles.

authoringOrConfigSources: RoleBundleTemplateDefinition when a GameForm wants reusable named authoring presets
local RoleAssignment/role-template binding config when persisted
authoritativeSourcesRemainElsewhere: GPR1 RoleAssignmentRecord and owner-local authority sources
GPR1 ScopedAuthorityEdge/AuthorityProfile as derived effective authority
sourceDerivedBoundary.reason: The label/preset is useful for authoring, UX and Agent context but must not become a hidden source of authority, capability or control.

RoleBundleTemplateDefinition.purpose: Define a reusable named practical role pattern as a set of responsibility slices and recommended needs while explicitly denying hidden grants.
RoleBundleTemplateDefinition.defaultAdmissionPolicy: NO_HIDDEN_GRANTS: template selection alone creates no effective authority, capability, control, observation access or case/enforcement/remedy power.
laws: template composition does not union authority automatically
localized/display label changes do not alter semantics when template/slice identities remain fixed

RoleBundleInstantiationPlan.purpose: Show what concrete local assignments, access policies, authority operations, capabilities/tools and separation policies would be required to realize a chosen role-bundle variant for a holder/context.
laws: plan generation may reveal no changes are needed when existing local sources already satisfy the template
template realization can legitimately omit optional slices
same template may instantiate differently across GameForms

RoleBundleManifest.purpose: Provide a compact current Human/Agent-facing view of what a concrete holder under a named role bundle actually observes, recommends, controls, decides, reviews, changes, enforces or remedies now.
laws: RoleBundleManifest is derived from actual current sources, not template promises
stale bundle manifest != current authority evidence
same label can produce materially different manifests
same holder can have multiple manifests/scoped bundles
provider/model identity should not determine bundle semantics

RoleBundleCompositionView.purpose: Expose how several bundle templates/slices are fused in one holder or distributed across several holders without assuming authority union, precedence or role hierarchy.
laws: one responsibility slice may be fulfilled by multiple holders or split across holders

RoleBundleCompatibilityDiagnostic.purpose: Detect hidden-grant assumptions, missing dependencies, authority/control/capability mismatches, invalid role fusion and separation-policy conflicts before a role bundle is used for Human/Agent context or runtime decisions.
laws: missing recommended slice is not an error when the local variant intentionally omits it
same-label differences are acceptable when explicit

RefereeJudge.purpose: Practical contest/rule-application official role family with separable observation, classification/recommendation, case determination, review and optional certification/enforcement slices.

sliceCatalog.notes: Receive scoped observations/evidence; access policy remains explicit.
Binding determination only if explicitly admitted.
Optional; never implied by judge label.

GameMaster.purpose: Composable facilitation/world-presentation/control/adjudication/experience-steering family for tabletop, roleplay, simulation and Agent-mediated forms.

sliceCatalog.notes: World/content authoring/presentation responsibility; authority depends on GameForm.
Control is separate from case authority.
May be advisory or standing interpretive authority depending local config.
Optional and distinct from interpretation/case ruling.

CoachAdvisor.purpose: Observation, analysis, recommendation and explanation family that is nonbinding by default and useful for Human or Agent assistance.

sliceCatalog.notes: Proposal rights distinct from action control/admission.
Only when explicitly granted; then control is not inferred from coach label.

Moderator.purpose: Policy/community/content governance family decomposed into observation/classification, case decision, review, policy change, consequence directive/enforcement and remedy coordination.

sliceCatalog.notes: Nonbinding unless current practice expressly treats classification as determination.

Operator.purpose: Technical/live operational execution family emphasizing capability, tools, observation and effectuation without implying normative decision authority.

sliceCatalog.notes: Technical recovery; not Game remedy by identity.
Owner-local; may or may not alter GDF0 rules.
Never implied just because operator has write tools.

ExperienceManager.purpose: Adaptive experience/pacing/content/difficulty/session-steering family with explicit bounded intervention and separation from adjudication/rule authority.

sliceCatalog.notes: May consume performance/engagement/session state without universal mind-reading.
Explicit scope and allowed interventions required.
Does not imply rule-change authority beyond declared parameter surface.
Optional separate authority, never implied by experience management.

TeamActorRole.finding: engineer/medic/security/coordinator drive objective routing, mandate/context and policy inputs. They are high-value local role vocabulary, but current authority outcome does not follow from the label alone and capabilities remain separately represented.

TeamCoordinatorRole.finding: coordinator is used for the task spanning the whole objective graph and wrapper execution. It should not be generalized into universal commander, GM or global authority semantics.

StationZeroRoleId.finding: roleId is stored beside controllerKind, capabilityIds, traits, equipment and faction. This is good evidence that functional role, control substrate and capability are distinct.

StationZeroControllerKind.finding: player/agent/policy/none says who/what realizes control for actor/faction, not what semantic role the entity occupies.

StationZeroStandingOrder.finding: standing orders bind strategy/context but tests explicitly preserve that they do not grant direct World mutation. This is a strong GPR5 anti-hidden-grant example.

MissionControlPlayerControls.finding: approve/deny/redirect/pause/provider/policy actions are specific product controls. They do not imply that Player is universally GM, Judge, Operator or rule authority.

CasefilePersonRole.finding: Archive technician/Lab systems engineer/Dock mechanic/Galley steward are narrative occupation labels with no generic RoleBundle authority semantics.

DeepSeekRoleDoctrine.finding: Engineer/Medic/Security doctrine guides candidate preference and responsibility behavior. The prompt does not itself grant Game action or rule authority.

AuthorityProfileRoleAttribute.finding: Team authority evidence includes the role in subject attributes/mandate, but the concrete local authority policy decides permit/require-human/deny; GPR5 must not generalize role attribute into automatic cross-Game authority.

implementationDecision.reason: Station Zero clearly benefits from local role profiles/doctrine/objective routing and Agent-facing role vocabulary, proving the pattern. But only one main GameForm currently consumes it, and generic Referee/GM/Moderator/Operator/ExperienceManager forms are not live consumers. A cross-Game framework would be premature.
safeImmediateCandidates: derive compact role/bundle manifests from existing Station Zero profile+capability+authority data for Agent/debug tooling without changing sources
add terminology/audit guards that role/controller/capability/authority are distinct
use the generic template contracts for future GameForm authoring rather than refactor current specialist enums
preserve bundleStateDigest/currentness pattern if a future Agent context exposes effective role authority
